correctness.rationale: The exact branch recurrence admits the \(n^{-1/(p-1)}\) rescaling. A Jensen lower comparison and inverse-power decrement localize all survivors. Euler convergence away from blow-up, a dyadic exit comparison for blow-up points, and zero-area monotone survivor boundary prove finite-parameter convergence. Mean/difference contraction for \(n\varepsilon_n\to\infty\) gives the synchronized scalar limit. Cooperative ODE comparison establishes monotone area, strict finite endpoint inequalities, and continuity. Finite code checks support but do not establish these infinite claims.

value.rationale: The first-exit exponent previously measured for this exact two-site map does not determine its coefficient. The theorem proves a natural one-parameter singular crossover at observation-time times coupling order one and a fixed-positive-coupling amplitude exactly twice the uncoupled amplitude, even though the exponent is unchanged. These resolve a motivated rare-event geometry problem rather than arbitrary small-size enumeration.
